objective: Exercise and prove the Developmental Editor against a corpus whose developmental defects are known and visible.

fixture_referent.label: MANUSCRIPT / Living the Spiralogic Process
fixture_referent.selected_because: It carries the known developmental defects — curriculum scaffolding, reintroduction, prospective residue, pitch register — in unusually visible form, which makes it a good acceptance corpus.
fixture_referent.not_a_claim: Selecting this fixture asserts NOTHING about which artifact is the authoritative Chapter 10. It is not thereby declared canonical.

work_referent.note: Manuscript custody is not decided here. Binding a Work referent is a separate founder act, required only if the editor is ever asked to MODIFY the book. Findings against the fixture are valid without it and are not provisional.

protagonist_doctrine.ruling: Maya is the protagonist for this fixture; her lived development teaches the Spiralogic Process. The dream is not an alternate protagonist for this test.

comparison_corpus_note: Read as archaeology — how this chapter changed across drafts. NOT a candidate list for the Work, and not a ranking of canonicity.
